                                                                IMPORTANT NOTES
If you have any questions or concerns, please contact, the water billing office @ 613-258-9569 or Email:
water@northgrenville.on.ca
Payments can be made at your Financial Insitution, North Grenville can be found as a PAYEE, listed as North
Grenville - Utilities. Alternately, payments may be made at the Municipality of North Grenville
Under Section 398(2) of the Municipal Act, 2001, Ontario municipalities may add unpaid water and sewer fees to a
property's tax roll. These arrears are collected in the same manner as municipal taxes.
